entities.name: Skrikkle
entities.description: Brave and careless goblin on Shandalar who went into danger-danger land and never returned.

entities.name: Snurkle
entities.description: Great grand-pap who made the stick from a Marauding Maulhorn tooth.

entities.name: Groggle
entities.description: Neighbor who scrambled for Skrikkle's skrill slime.

events.summary: Skrikkle sets out to hunt grubs in danger-danger land with his great grand-pap's stick.
events.quote: went into danger-danger land to hunt for grubs

events.summary: A Fleshpulper Giant stamps on Skrikkle, flattening him.
events.quote: both Skrikkle, his maulhorn stick, and all his epic future conquests were thoroughly flattened

relations.quote: wipe the smug smirk off his rival
